question: Integrated circuits contain a large number of transistors on a small semiconductor chip. Explain why this improves the performance of electronic circuits.

options.A: Many transistors on one chip increase circuit size and length of connections, so speed decreases.
options.B: Integrated circuits place many transistors and components on one chip. Short connection lengths improve speed and reduce power consumption, while fewer external connections improve reliability and compactness.
options.C: Integration improves circuits by increasing the number of soldered joints and external wires, which raises reliability.
options.D: Integrated circuits improve performance only by increasing the operating voltage, not by reducing size or connections.
